استشعرن (form X)
# اِسْتَشْعَرْنَ (istašʕarna) /is.taʃ.ʕar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اُسْتُشْعِرْنَ (ustušʕirna) /us.tuʃ.ʕir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اِسْتَشْعِرْنَ (istašʕirna) /is.taʃ.ʕir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
